title: Kforce kicks off fifth annual Season of Impact with recognition for community service
summary: Kforce launches its fifth annual Season of Impact while earning recognition for its continued commitment to community service and giving.
body_markdown:
# **Kforce kicks off fifth annual Season of Impact with recognition for community service**


***The firm’s annual stewardship initiative begins with volunteer opportunities supporting students, children and communities in Tampa Bay and nationwide.***


****


**TAMPA, FL (October 2026)** – Kforce has launched its fifth annual Season of I


mpact, bringing Kforcers together to support causes and communities throughout the fall and winter months.


Season of Impact grew from Kforce’s Day of Giving, which began in 2016, and continues the firm’s longstanding commitment to


cre


ating meaningful change through volunteerism, charitable giving and community partnerships.


This year’s Season of Impact begins with several October activities across the Tampa Bay area. Kforce volunteers will support a birthday celebration at Hope Children’s Home and take part in Junior Achievement 3DE programs at local high schools. Through coaching, consulting and judging, Kforcers can apply their professional experience while helping students work through real-world business challenges.


The campaign will continue through the end of the year with more ways to volunteer and give, including virtual drives benefiting Feeding Tampa Bay and Metropolitan Ministries. While many firm-organized activities benefit Tampa-area organizations and corporate charity partners, employees across the country are encouraged to find meaningful ways to serve their own communities.


This year’s launch comes as the Tampa Bay Business Journal names Kforce a 2026 One Tampa Bay honoree for its nonprofit work and corporate philanthro


py.


“Season of Impact brings our commitment to service to life through our people and community partners,” said Senior Director of Communications and Stewardship Chair Crystal Early. “This recognition reflects what we can accomplish together.”


Kforce’s stewardship efforts continue year-round, guided by three community engagement pillars: education, community development and human services. Together, these focus areas help Kforcers create meaningful change where they live and work.


**About Kforce**


Kforce is a solutions firm specializing in technology, finance and accounting, and professional staffing services. Our KNOWLEDGEforce® empowers top companies to achieve their digital transformation goals. We curate teams of technical experts who deliver solutions custom-tailored to each client’s needs. These scalable, flexible outcomes are shaped by deep market knowledge, thought leadership and our multi-industry expertise.


Our integrated approach is rooted in 60 years of proven success deploying highly skilled professionals on a temporary and direct-hire basis. Each year, approximately 17,000 talented experts work with the Fortune 500 and other leading companies. Together, we deliver Great Results Through Strategic Partnership and Knowledge Sharing®.
